data.text: I’m on board with 10 tons each, and that’s what I’ll select. Luke, thanks for the offer, but you’re part of this fishing community now—you should have an equal share, not sit out to give us a bonus. Leaving 50 tons means we can keep earning without borrowing from next month. Let’s review the catches together afterward and adjust the total cap if the lake ever starts below 100. Jack, does that work for you? Luke, will you join us?
